detail.title: Detecting Unrecognized Reasoning Blind Spots in LLMs
detail.question: How can autonomous agents identify reasoning blind spots that their architectural designers have not explicitly mitigated?
detail.reason: Active focus on metacognitive limits and error correction.

children.title: Frameworks for Autonomous Reasoning Error Attribution

detail.title: Frameworks for Autonomous Reasoning Error Attribution
detail.summary: Reasoning blind spots often arise from implicit, unchecked assumptions embedded in model training. By leveraging causal editing, we can isolate the specific reasoning nodes that lead to circular or biased logic. This framework aids in attribution but does not automatically remediate all classes of meta-reasoning failure.
detail.reason: Applying CAKE to the problem of reasoning error attribution.
